## Responses

```{r}
tar_read(hist_raw)
```

## Scores by region

```{r}
knitr::kable(tar_read(region_summary), digits = 2)
```

## Model

```{r}
tar_read(coef_plot)
```

```{r}
preds <- tar_read(predictions)
```

The model explains the scores with a mean absolute error of
`r round(mean(abs(preds$score - preds$predicted)), 2)` points.
